_doc: Terrains laid on another georeference than their NewTerrain/Theater.txt projection string names. Used by the extractor for what it projects from latitude and longitude (Natural Earth borders and provinces, geo.mjs). Model 'sinusoidal': east metres = R * (lon - lon0) * cos(lat), north metres = R * (lat - lat0), R = 6371008.8 m (degrees as radians); then x (north feet) = x[0]*east + x[1]*north + x[2] and y (east feet) = y[0]*east + y[1]*north + y[2]. Refit with tools: the affine least-squares over real airport reference points against the theater's own airport records.

mideast._src: Fitted on 2026-11-18 to 34 airports of Mideast4_38 (Add-On Mideast128, a 4.36/4.37 theater converted to 4.38's New Terrain keeping its original georeference) against their real reference points: median 0.90 km, worst 2.69 km (an objective's centre is not its airport's reference point). Every transverse Mercator tried (the string's own +lon_0=47.1 +lat_0=29.8 +k=1, or about the centre) left a median of 6.3 km and up to 16 km; the string's +x_0=0 +y_0=0 put the theater's centre 3,288 km north of the grid's middle. Left out of the fit: Kuwait International Airport and King Khalid Military Airbase (over 3 km).
